Select molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles From molecule_dictionary Join activities On molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Where target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2A' And target_dictionary.target_type = 'PROTEIN' And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' Sort By compound_chembl_id
